## Problem
What user need does this address?

## Proposed behavior
Describe the smallest useful behavior and any API/service boundary changes.

## Safety and compatibility
Consider credentials, authorization, Prowler safety, attribution, and migration impact.

Do not include cloud credentials, account identifiers, or sensitive infrastructure data.
